title: mix-129-nj6 (new, serving) vs lgbm-094-cap900 (old) — prospective paired comparison
registered_by: Claude (session 2026-09-13), reviewed by codex exec (design review, same session)

registration_state.results_in_window_at_registration: 0 result rows for any race on or after 2026-09-13 (the first race of 2026-09-13 starts 00:45 UTC; results are ingested by the evening refresh). Verified by the first interim score run recorded in evidence/looks.jsonl.
registration_state.records_existing_at_registration: 24 races of 2026-09-13 captured 00:16-00:17 UTC by the 129 tool (preweight + serving regimes) and 24 production_snapshot records derived from the pre-start production run of 2026-09-12 14:13-14:17 UTC. Their outcomes were unknown when this file was written; they are included.
registration_state.supersedes: specs/129-candidate-mixture-serving confirmation draft window 2026-09-12..2026-12-28 (never reserved; it added a transferred retraining sd to the CI, which this registration does not).

comparators.new_kind: six-member LightGBM mixture: members joint-42/43/44 (125 columns, 13 relative-ability drops) and anchor-42/43/44 (138 columns), each booster 900 rounds + OOF isotonic (8 blocks) + weight mask 0.5 + TE 10; residual correction with the 2026 coefficients (gap_log, prior_gap_log, female_sin, female_cos, centered_logp for joint members; gap_log for anchor members); WIN = equal-weight mean of the six corrected win vectors
comparators.old_kind: single LightGBM pl_topk booster (arm E: OOF isotonic calibration, 900 rounds, weight mask) on the same 138 features-021 columns; WIN = booster raw score -> isotonic -> clip -> race normalisation
comparators.display_convention: top2/top3 = assemble_predictions(eps=1e-6): clip -> race-normalise -> Harville with stage discount λ2/λ3 (the production display rule, 049/131). Both models share the frozen λ inside a record; the production λ of the day is stored beside it (display_production_lambda) for correspondence only.
comparators.display_lambda_source: 129 anchor stage discount, fit once with before_date=2026-08-24 (artifact sha256 0983175af3b2b7356d7f0080f57468a9705ad985d13886b673b5c78362543da5)
comparators.research_heads: the mixture's averaged member top2/top3 are stored as new_research_heads_not_served and are never used in any served-head metric

input_contract.rows: as-of feature matrix build_feature_matrix(end_date=race_date, target_race_ids) of the started horses; the mixture additionally reads the started history (race_horses started rows strictly before the day) for prior_gap

estimand: Difference in expected per-race winner NLL between two FIXED artifacts on future JRA races, input condition preweight, new minus old (negative = new better). Both artifacts are frozen files; the uncertainty quantified is sampling over future race days only. Retraining variance is a different question and is reported beside the CI, never inside it.

primary.regime_definition: the three same-day weight columns (weight, weight_diff, carried_weight_ratio) set to NaN for every started horse of the race, on rows acquired before the start; this is a fixed input condition applied identically to both models
primary.metric: race-weighted mean of -log(p_model(winner)); paired per race; one race = one observation
primary.probability_clipping: p clipped to [1e-15, 1] before the log; the served probabilities are already in [1e-6, 1-1e-6] so the clip never binds

sources.capture: paired_prospective capture: both models on the same acquired rows, pre-start re-checked through a fresh connection after the last prediction
sources.shadow_129: mixture_shadow capture records (same paired acquisition; served top2/top3 re-derived from the recorded win with the frozen λ)
sources.production_snapshot: pre-start production run of mix-129-nj6 (computed_at < scheduled_start; run rows are append-only) whose feature_snapshots reproduce the persisted win to 1e-9; the old model is then predicted on those frozen rows later. Weight publication state of these rows is unknown_zero_or_partial unless all weighed.
sources.rule: exactly one record per race; a rejected higher-precedence record never falls back to a lower one (the race is rejected); production_snapshot is pooled into the primary analysis and also shown separately by source

exclusion_protocol_in_order.rule: classification != prospective or pre_result != true (rehearsal records are never evidence)
bundle sha / anchor sha / display λ differ from this registration
the scored regime is absent from the record
either model lacks a prediction for a started horse
PENDING (not excluded): no result rows yet

result rows exist for a horse not in the captured started set, or a captured horse has no result row and the current started set differs (scratch after capture, late addition, cancellation). The race is excluded: renormalising the captured vectors would evaluate a forecast nobody made.
PENDING: captured set == current started set but some result rows are still missing
not exactly one captured horse with finish_order == 1 (first-place dead heat)
a result_status other than finished/stopped aborts scoring loudly (never silently mapped)

labels.top2: finished and finish_order <= 2 (a dead heat at 2nd gives three in-top2 horses; kept as-is)
labels.stopped: result_status stopped (finish_order NULL) -> 0 for every head; the horse stays in the started population

secondary_metrics: per-race Brier of the win head (mean over started horses of (p - y)^2), new and old
per-horse log loss, Brier and equal-mass ECE (10 bins, tie-safe) for win/top2/top3 under the served convention with the frozen λ
top-1 agreement between models and top-1 hit rate of each (argmax of win, ties -> horse_id order)
leave-one-day-out shift of the point estimate (influence diagnostic)

bootstrap.method: race_day_cluster_bootstrap_ci_v1 (percentile CI of the mean paired diff; whole race days resampled with replacement; races within a day move together)
bootstrap.caveat: approximate coverage: ~24-32 day clusters; weekend days of the same meeting may be dependent; leave-one-day-out shift is reported to show influential days

conditions_descriptive_only.rule: subgroup results are descriptive; no subgroup can change the verdict

window.basis: to = last JRA race day inside the 2026 validity of the new model's residual coefficients (serving tolerates 2027 with coefstale=1 but this comparison does not extend into it). min_eval_days = 24 comes from the 129 power plan (day-cluster SD 0.0123 from 4 rehearsal days; 0.01 effect detectable at 98.75%) and is a completeness requirement for the final readout, NOT a minimum effect: any difference, however small, is reported with its CI.
window.completeness: final readout requires today > to (JST), no recorded race pending results, no scheduled race of the window without results, and n_days >= min_eval_days; race days without any record are disclosed in coverage, they do not block (captures are manual) and the window is never extended

decision_rule: FINAL verdict from the primary 95% CI of the preweight paired winner-NLL difference (new - old): NEW_BETTER if CI high < 0; OLD_BETTER if CI low > 0; otherwise INCONCLUSIVE with the point estimate reported. No minimum effect. The 98.75% CI is reported for continuity with the 112 annual budget but does not decide.
interim_policy: interim score runs are allowed at any time, are labelled INTERIM_STATUS_NOT_A_VERDICT, never carry a verdict, and are appended to evidence/looks.jsonl; the window, method and this file do not change in response to interim numbers (amendments require a new registration file and a note in README)

retraining_variance_note.status: historical context from 100/129 (single-model refit noise), not a validated uncertainty estimate for re-training this six-member bundle; reported beside the CI, never added to it, never divided by sqrt(6)

recorded_per_race: db_weight_state_at_capture (0/partial/all started horses weighed in the database at acquisition; 0 can also be ingestion lag)
serving regime prediction (091 race-level binarisation) and serving_equals_preweight
production_link: latest pre-start production run (id, logic_version with wregime and rounded λ, computed_at, seconds before start, persisted heads, max |win diff| vs the capture's serving-regime win)
production_stage_discount_of_day (λ re-fit with the production function and cutoff)
production_correspondence.known_drift: as-of inputs move between the production run (typically the evening before) and a race-morning capture when corner orders or other late fields of earlier races are ingested; observed 2026-09-13: 5 of 24 races with |Δwin| 0.0015-0.0098. Each record keeps its own typed inputs, so the pair inside a record is always simultaneous.

out_of_scope: 112 confirmation ledger reservation (requires an independent review the operator must obtain; this readout is a post-hoc confirmation of the 2026-09-09 override)
